evidence.title: Paper page - DyBluRF: Dynamic Deblurring Neural Radiance Fields for Blurry Monocular Video

name: DyBluRF: Dynamic Deblurring Neural Radiance Fields for Blurry Monocular Video
summary: Paper page for DyBluRF, a NeRF framework that deblurs blurry monocular video to synthesise sharp novel views.
description: Paper page for DyBluRF (2023), a dynamic deblurring NeRF framework for blurry monocular video: an Interleave Ray Refinement stage reconstructs the dynamic 3D scene and refines camera pose, and a Motion Decomposition-based Deblurring stage splits latent sharp rays into global camera motion and local object motion. Source code and pretrained models are linked from the project page; the abstract is followed by a discussion thread, similar-paper recommendations and citing models, datasets and Spaces.
